title.zh: 卷二百十五 表第六 宗室世系一
title.en: Volume 215 Tables 6: Geneology of the Imperial Clan 1
title.raw: 卷二百十五 表第六 宗室世系一 Volume 215 Tables 6: Geneology of the Imperial Clan 1

sentences.zh: 昔者帝王之有天下，莫不眾建同姓以樹蕃屏，其不得以有國者，則亦授之土田，使帥其宗氏，輯其族分，故繼別之宗，百世不遷。

translations.literal: In antiquity when emperors and kings possessed the realm, none failed to establish many of the same surname to erect feudal screens; those who could not be granted states were also given land and fields, made to lead their clans by descent, and gather their kin by branch—thus the ancestral lines distinguished by succession did not shift for a hundred generations.
translations.idiomatic: In ancient times, whenever emperors and kings held the realm, they invariably enfeoffed many kinsmen of the same surname to serve as feudal bulwarks. Those who could not be given a state were granted land instead, charged to lead their ancestral clans and keep their collateral lines in order—so that the lines of succession set apart by ritual descent might endure for a hundred generations without change.

sentences.zh: 豈惟賴其崇獎，維持以成不拔之基哉。

translations.literal: Was it not only by relying on their lofty rewards and sustaining them that an unshakeable foundation was formed?
translations.idiomatic: Surely it was only by honoring and sustaining them in this way that an unshakeable foundation for the throne could be laid.

sentences.zh: 蓋親親之仁，為國大經理固然也周官，宗伯掌三族之別，以辨親疎，於是敘昭穆而禮法之降殺行焉，此世系之所以不可不謹也。

translations.literal: For the benevolence of cherishing kin is a great constant of statecraft; it is indeed so in the Offices of Zhou—the Director of the Ancestral Temple regulated the distinctions of the three clans to differentiate near and distant kin; thereby the ordering of zhao and mu was set forth and the gradations of ritual law applied—this is why genealogies must not be treated carelessly.
translations.idiomatic: The virtue of loving one's own kin is a fundamental principle of governance. In the Offices of Zhou, the Director of the Ancestral Temple kept the three clans distinct to distinguish degrees of relationship; from this came the ordering of senior and junior lines and the graduated observances of ritual law. That is why genealogical records must be maintained with the utmost care.

sentences.zh: 後世封建廢而宗法壞，帝王之裔至或雜於民、伍淪為皂隸，甚可歎也。

translations.literal: In later ages feudal enfeoffment was abolished and the clan law broken, so that imperial descendants even mingled with commoners and some sank to the ranks of menials—deeply lamentable.
translations.idiomatic: In later ages, when feudal enfeoffment was abolished and clan law fell into ruin, descendants of emperors sometimes sank among the common people, and some were reduced to menial status—a matter deeply to be lamented.

sentences.zh: 宋太祖太宗魏王之子孫可謂蕃衍盛大矣，支子而下各以一字別其昭穆而宗正所掌，有牒、有籍、有錄、有圖、有譜以敘其系，而第其服屬之達近刑其男女婚姻及官爵敘遷而著其功罪生死歲月，雖封國之制不可以復古，而宗法之嚴恩禮之厚亦可概見。

translations.literal: The descendants of Song Taizu, Taizong, and the Prince of Wei may be called abundantly propagated and grand; from collateral sons downward each used one character to distinguish zhao and mu, while the Director of the Imperial Clan kept registers, rolls, records, charts, and genealogies to narrate their lines, ranked the degrees of mourning obligation, regulated male and female marriage, and noted promotions and demotions of office and rank, recording merits and faults, life and death, and years and months—although the system of enfeoffed states could not be restored to antiquity, the strictness of clan law and the thickness of gracious ritual can be seen in outline.
translations.idiomatic: The descendants of Taizu, Taizong, and the Prince of Wei of Song had become remarkably numerous. From collateral lines downward, a single character distinguished each branch within the larger lineage, while the Directorate of the Imperial Clan maintained dossiers, registers, records, charts, and genealogies to trace every line. It ranked degrees of kinship for mourning, regulated marriages, tracked promotions and demotions in office, and recorded merits and faults, births and deaths, and dates—so that although the ancient system of territorial enfeoffment could not be restored, the rigor of clan law and the generosity of imperial favor toward the kindred can still be seen in broad outline.

sentences.zh: 然靖康之變，往往淪徙死亡於兵難，南渡所存十無二三，而國之枝葉日以悴矣。

translations.literal: Yet at the Jingkang disaster many were lost, displaced, or died in the calamity of war; of those who crossed south not one or two in ten remained, and the branches and leaves of the state daily withered.
translations.idiomatic: Yet after the disaster of Jingkang, countless clansmen were lost, displaced, or killed in the wars. Of those who survived the flight south, scarcely two or three in ten remained, and the dynasty's collateral branches grew daily more depleted.

sentences.zh: 今因載籍之舊，考其原委，作宗室世系表。

translations.literal: Now, following the old records, tracing origins and developments, I compose the Genealogical Tables of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly, drawing on the surviving records and tracing origins and developments, I have compiled the Genealogical Tables of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 太祖四子，長滕王德秀、次燕王德昭、次舒王德林、次秦王德芳。

translations.literal: Taizu had four sons: the eldest, Prince of Teng Dexiu; second, Prince of Yan Dezhao; third, Prince of Shu Delin; fourth, Prince of Qin Defang.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu had four sons: the eldest was Dexiu, Prince of Teng; the second, Dezhao, Prince of Yan; the third, Delin, Prince of Shu; and the fourth, Defang, Prince of Qin.

translations.literal: Dexiu and Delin had no descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Dexiu and Delin left no heirs.
